text:
Pausing is on the list of everyday changes, so nothing needs your approval first. I'd run:

```sh
sudo tentmaker pause --for 8h --json gaming
tentmaker budget --json
```

The first command pauses CI for 8 hours with the reason "gaming". The second confirms the device shows as paused.

- **Running jobs:** a job already in progress will finish, since pause only stops new ones from starting. If one is running when you start your game, you'll see some load until it ends.
- **Duration:** you didn't give one, so I picked 8 hours to cover the evening. I can use a different value if you prefer.
- **Ending it early:** once you're done, run `sudo tentmaker resume`.
